srcs.episode: Karl Bartos. Una importante influencia en la sombra

podcast.body: This important and interesting album was released approximately three years prior to the discussion. It is not a new recording but a compilation of old tapes Carl Bartons discovered during a house move. These tapes contained numerous recordings he had made for the *Radioactivity* album that were either never finished or were surplus material. Carl Bartons compiled the best of these recordings, which were not heavily promoted, but are of great interest to Craguer fans, often interpreted as the unreleased B-sides of *Radioactivity*. The album transports listeners back to 1975 and illuminates the unique contributions Carl Bartons brought to Craguer's sound that were not present before his involvement. "sacó este famoso O of the Record, que no tuvo mucha promoción, pero para los que se han fan de Craguerk les va a interesar un montón."

srcs.episode: Karl Bartos. Una importante influencia en la sombra

podcast.body: This solo album by Karl Bartos comprises recordings from the "radioactíbitica" period (likely referencing Kraftwerk's "Radio-Activity" era) that he created but was not permitted to use within Crabwork by Ralph Hütter and Florian Schneider. The material was eventually published years after its creation. "tuvimos la publicación de ese álbum de Carbarto en solitario of the records, que eran todas esas grabaciones del radioactíbitica, había hecho Carbarto y que Ralph Yfloria no le habían dejado utilizar."
